intent: The keyboard shortcut hint shown at the end of a context menu row.
typical_uses: The key combination that runs the same action outside the menu, such as Ctrl+C beside Copy

dont_use_when.situation: A key or key combination shown in running text or outside a menu row

invariants.text: The shortcut is text only: it registers no key handler and adds no `aria-keyshortcuts`, so the application binds the keys itself.

context-menu.module.css pushes the shortcut to the inline end of its row and renders it in the muted foreground color, switching to the accent foreground while a ContextMenuItem, ContextMenuCheckboxItem or ContextMenuRadioItem holding it is highlighted.

good.title: A shortcut hint on an action
A shortcut hint on a setting

bad.title: A Kbd used as the row's shortcut hint
bad.why: ContextMenuItem accepts ContextMenuShortcut, not Kbd; a Kbd is not pushed to the end of the row and keeps its muted chip colors when the row is highlighted.
